descriptionChirho: To locate, come upon, or discover someone or something, whether by deliberate search or unexpectedly (Arabic wajada/yajidu, Korean 찾았다/발견했다, Swahili -pata/-kuta).
Passive: to be found, be discovered, turn up, or turn out to be (Arabic wujida/yujad, Korean 발견되었다, Swahili -patikana/-onekana).
To acquire or secure something, where finding implies gaining possession (Spanish habiendo-obtenido, Korean 얻으셨으니, distinct from mere discovery).
